pois.label: 摆镜扫描头(天顶阶梯+定标一体)
pois.detail: 筒轴端的摆镜鼓绕水平光轴旋转,45° 折转镜把水平光路指向任意仰角。一个机构做四件事:天顶阶梯 0/30/48.2/60/70.5°(气质量 1/1.15/1.5/2/3)扫天空;140° 停位下视地面(俯角 50°,斜程 1.96 m),用已知地表亮温标定旁瓣耦合;180° 扣鼓下方黑体做两点定标;黑体位的硬限位同时是机械零位,每 24 s 回零一次把热弯曲漂移清零。HATPRO/ALMA WVR 同构,但那第三、第四个用途是本设计自己算出来的。
pois.detail_en: The drum at the tube end rotates about the horizontal optical axis, its 45-deg fold mirror steering the beam to any elevation. One mechanism does four jobs: the zenith ladder 0/30/48.2/60/70.5 deg (airmass 1/1.15/1.5/2/3) scans sky; a 140-deg stop (50 deg below horizontal, 1.96 m slant) looks down at the ground, calibrating sidelobe coupling against a known surface brightness; 180 deg looks into the blackbody for two-point radiometric calibration; and that blackbody hard stop doubles as the mechanical home, re-zeroing thermal-bending drift every 24 s. The architecture is HATPRO / ALMA-WVR, but the third and fourth uses were derived here.

specs.轴承: MoS₂ 溅射干膜(150 K 裕度 7.6×)
specs.展示映射: 鼓转角=天顶角(实物折转镜转 za/2)

specs_en.Four stops: sky / 140 deg ground (50 deg dip, 1.96 m slant) / 180 deg blackbody / home
specs_en.Bearings: sputtered MoS2 dry film (7.6x margin at 150 K)
specs_en.Display mapping: drum angle = zenith angle (real fold mirror moves za/2)

sim: 指向与斜程账(sim_antenna.py):倾斜扫描的货币不是增益(扩展源无所谓)而是气质量标度——0.06° 指向误差在 za=70.5° 只造成 0.30% 的 τ 标度误差;平大气 sec 近似对球面修正的偏差 2.4%@70.5°,已入反演;窗口通道 τ≈0.005 单轮 tipping 可解到 ~15%
热漂移与回零账(sim_mech_frost.py):首轮归因于铝-钢差胀算出 113% 超预算是错的——对称双板轭架同步膨胀不产生倾斜,倾斜要不对称;真机制是向阳/背阴 15 K 横向梯度弯曲 1.30 m 立柱 0.129°(预算 216%)。修法不加硬件:黑体硬限位既是辐射基准也是机械零位,热弯曲时常数 ~1 h 而回零周期 24 s,残留仅 0.00086°

地面停位账(sim_beameff/groundcal.py,评审 F2 后定量化):主镜远旁瓣地面拾取在设计阶段夹在 1e-5~8.9 K 跨 6 量级;tipping 阶梯与 sec 律相关 0.87(VIF 4.0)——评审拆掉了首稿那个自造阈值的布尔判决,换成三个数:理想两参数拟合统计后验 0.041 K(含增益漂移底)、0.03 K sec 律模型误差经共线性泄漏 0.002 K、需求 0.392 K。结论修正:**阶梯在理想模型下统计够用**,但通道维度拟合(相关仅 0.18)完全不依赖 sec 律形状,是稳健路径;140° 停位供地面亮温(近场,账 10),地表温度由 sci-weather-01 与 sci-ir-01 独立提供
轴承低温账(sim_mech_frost.py):−123 ℃ 下润滑脂 µ 由 0.0025 涨到 0.35,启动力矩 350 mNm、裕度掉到 2.5× 且需预热循环;MoS₂ 溅射干膜 µ=0.015、15 mNm、裕度 7.6×
sim_en: Pointing & slant account (sim_antenna.py): for an extended scene the currency is not gain but the airmass scale — a 0.06-deg pointing error costs only 0.30% in tau scale at za=70.5; the flat-sec approximation deviates 2.4% from the spherical integral there (folded into retrieval); window-channel tau ~0.005 resolves to ~15% per tipping ladder

Thermal drift and re-homing (sim_mech_frost.py): the first pass blamed Al-vs-steel differential expansion and got 113% of budget — wrong, a symmetric two-plate yoke expands symmetrically and does not tilt; tilt needs asymmetry. The real driver is a 15 K sun-shade gradient bending the 1.30 m column by 0.129 deg (216% of budget). The fix adds no hardware: the blackbody hard stop is both the radiometric reference and the mechanical home, and with a ~1 h bending time constant against a 24 s re-home the residual is 0.00086 deg

Ground-stop account (sim_beameff/groundcal.py, quantified after review F2): design-stage far-sidelobe pickup brackets six decades (1e-5 to 8.9 K); the tipping ladder correlates 0.87 with the sec-law (VIF 4.0) — review removed the first draft's invented-threshold boolean verdict and replaced it with three numbers: idealised 2-parameter statistical posterior 0.041 K (gain-drift floor included), 0.002 K leakage from a 0.03 K sec-law model error through the collinearity, 0.392 K required. Corrected conclusion: the ladder IS statistically sufficient under an exact model, but the channel-dimension fit (correlation just 0.18) does not lean on the sec-law shape at all and remains the robust path; the 140-deg stop supplies ground brightness (near field, account 10) with surface temperature from sci-weather-01 and sci-ir-01 independently

Cold bearing account (sim_mech_frost.py): at -123 C grease friction rises from mu 0.0025 to 0.35 — 350 mNm break-away, margin down to 2.5x and needing a warm-up cycle; sputtered MoS2 dry film gives mu 0.015, 15 mNm, margin 7.6x
pois.physics: tipping 原理:ln(信号) 对气质量 m=sec(za) 回归,斜率就是天顶不透明度 τ、截距就是定标点——把大气自己当标准源,与气象站光度计的 Langley 法是同一个母题
pois.physics_en: Tipping principle: regress ln(signal) on airmass m = sec(za); the slope IS the zenith opacity and the intercept the calibration point — the atmosphere itself is the standard source, the same motif as the met station's Langley method on its sun photometer

pois.label: 工程图板(探测原理 + 电路)
pois.detail: 坪角上的展板把两张设计图搬进城里,用三维查看器唯一能渲染的形式——几何。左半是火星 183 GHz 水汽线的形状与六个通道刻度(紫=3 MHz 线心到灰=1.5 GHz 窗口),这就是探测原理本身:压致展宽让 γ(z)∝p(z),偏置频率因此成为高度旋钮。右半的表盘是摆镜四停位:蓝=天顶阶梯(0→70.5°)、绿=140° 地面停位、红=180° 黑体。完整图纸(含接收机电路、反并联肖特基对、OCXO 锁相本振链)见 figure 字段所列文件。
pois.detail_en: The easel at the pad corner brings the two design drawings into the city in the only form a 3D viewer can render — geometry. Its left half is the shape of the martian 183 GHz water line with the six channel ticks (violet 3 MHz core through grey 1.5 GHz window): that IS the sounding principle, since pressure broadening makes gamma(z) ~ p(z) and turns frequency offset into an altitude knob. The dial on the right is the scan drum's four stops: blue = zenith ladder (0 to 70.5 deg), green = 140 deg ground stop, red = 180 deg blackbody. The full drawings — receiver chain, antiparallel Schottky pair, OCXO-locked LO chain — are the files listed under `figure`.

pois.physics: 为什么图纸值得进城:这台仪器的核心机理是"看不见"的——压致展宽、DSB 折叠、两点定标的共模抵消,都没有可直接观察的几何。展板与柜门 FFTS 屏是把这些机理外化的两个装置,它们讲同一个故事:线有多窄、通道落在哪、镜子转到哪一档。
pois.physics_en: Why the drawings belong in the city: this instrument's core mechanisms are invisible — pressure broadening, sideband folding, the common-mode cancellation of two-point calibration have no directly observable geometry. The board and the FFTS door screen are the two devices that externalise them, and they tell one story: how narrow the line is, where the channels sit, and which stop the mirror has turned to.

pois.label: 准光学链(抛物镜+波纹喇叭)
pois.detail: 剖开的水平镜筒里:150 mm 离轴抛物镜把 0.74° 铅笔波束聚给波纹喇叭(口径半径 2.31 mm,金色),喇叭直接坐在混频器块上。183 GHz 波长 1.64 mm,镜面精度只要 λ/60=27 µm——普通机加工即可,火星尘对镜面的威胁大于加工公差。
pois.detail_en: Inside the cutaway horizontal tube: a 150 mm off-axis paraboloid focuses the 0.74-deg pencil beam onto the corrugated feed horn (2.31 mm aperture radius, gold) sitting directly on the mixer block. At 183 GHz the wavelength is 1.64 mm, so the surface budget is just lambda/60 = 27 um — ordinary machining; martian dust threatens the mirror more than tolerances do.

specs.喇叭: 波纹锥,口径 r=2.31 mm,~17.4 dBi
specs.表面相关长度: ≥2 mm 金刚石车削(管地面拾取)
specs.缝沿处理: 滚圆 ≥3λ 或锯齿(锦上添花——评审后地面向边缘项 0.0004 K)

specs_en.Slot rim: rolled >=3 lambda or serrated (belt-and-braces; post-review ground-directed edge term 0.0004 K)

sim: 喇叭全波背书(hfss_horn_183.py,HFSS 2026.1 无头,几何比 mars-com-relay 32 GHz 先例缩 5.7×):光壁锥喇叭代理,旋转体一体成形+内腔体积断言 92.4 mm³,辐射边界按面分类(与 PEC 壁共面的面绝不赋辐射——Ka 喇叭先例最贵一坑);结果 18.33 dBi / S11 −28.0 dB / FWHM 20°(E)×24°(H)——高斯光学预测 FWHM≈23.5°、-12 dB 边缘锥削全波正中,解析 17.4 dBi 的 0.69 效率假设保守 0.9 dB,准光账照单成立

远旁瓣数值账(sim_sidelobe.py):账8a 把地面拾取悬在 1e-5~8.9 K 跨 6 量级,本账把三源各自算出——截断衍射(数值 Hankel:缝处截断 −35.3 dB,20° 处 −85.8 dB)1.7e-3 K 可忽略、鼓缝边缘绕射 1.5e-3 K 可忽略、**Ruze 表面散射主导 1.49 K**。关键发现:σ=27 µm 只决定散射掉 4.2% 的功率(增益规格),**散射到哪里由表面相关长度决定**——同样 27 µm 下 c=0.5 mm 给 7.33 K、c=2 mm 给 1.49 K、c=5 mm 给 0.0002 K,跨三个量级全来自一条账4 从没写过的规格。故新增规格:相关长度 ≥2 mm=单点金刚石车削(进给纹)而非研磨抛光,比收紧 rms 便宜且才是真正管用的参数。三个数值 bug 由主瓣效率闸门抓获(0.459 vs 声称 0.95):u=k·sinθ 在 θ>90° 折回让后半球镜像成主瓣;孔径积分只对前向半球有效,修正后 0.958 对 0.95 一致

边缘绕射与形状误差棒(sim_shapeerr.py,评审 F3 后重做、结论翻回):首稿把 99% 分位截断的半平面 Sommerfeld 积分称作'精确解'得 0.077 K=预算 40%——评审证明该数由截断旋钮决定(98%→99.9% 摆 ×15),恰是本账批判账 8b 的失误模式换壳。去旋钮版把物理劈开:影界能量跟光束走、打场景不打地面;地面向扇区从 ψ_min=90°−za=19.5° 起(扫描几何钉死,非选取)积分自行收敛 → **0.0004 K=预算 0.23%,回到可忽略**;总绕射功率以 UTD 区间(3.9e-4~6.0e-3)悬置,花 Tsys 不花定标;缝沿滚圆/锯齿降级为锦上添花。形状误差棒结论不变:c 在 1–5 mm 让幅度变几个量级但归一化形状最大偏 0.45;错形状反演按规格劈两半(达标 c≥1.5 mm 柱偏 ≤0.25%、研磨面 c=1 mm 柱偏 5.82%)——**相关长度规格做两份工**
sim_en: Horn full-wave backing (hfss_horn_183.py, headless HFSS 2026.1, 5.7x smaller than the mars-com-relay 32 GHz precedent): smooth-wall conical stand-in, solid-of-revolution build with a 92.4 mm3 cavity-volume assertion, radiation boundary classified per face (never on faces coincident with the PEC wall — the costliest Ka-horn lesson); results 18.33 dBi / S11 -28.0 dB / FWHM 20 deg (E) x 24 deg (H) — the Gaussian-optics prediction (FWHM ~23.5 deg, -12 dB edge taper) lands dead-on, the analytic 17.4 dBi was 0.9 dB conservative in its 0.69 efficiency assumption; the quasi-optics ledger stands as written

Numerical far-sidelobe account (sim_sidelobe.py): account 8a left ground pickup bracketed across six decades (1e-5 to 8.9 K); this one computes all three sources — truncation diffraction (numerical Hankel: clipped at -35.3 dB, -85.8 dB at 20 deg) 1.7e-3 K negligible, slot-edge diffraction 1.5e-3 K negligible, and **Ruze surface scatter dominant at 1.49 K**. The key finding: sigma=27 um sets only HOW MUCH power scatters (4.2%, the gain spec), while WHERE it goes is set by the surface correlation length — at the same 27 um, c=0.5 mm gives 7.33 K, c=2 mm gives 1.49 K, c=5 mm gives 0.0002 K, three decades from a spec account 4 never wrote down. Hence the new requirement: correlation length >=2 mm, i.e. single-point diamond turning (feed-mark limited) rather than abrasive polishing — cheaper than tightening rms and the parameter that actually governs the term. Three numerical bugs were caught by the beam-efficiency gate (0.459 vs the claimed 0.95): u = k sin(theta) folds back past 90 deg, mirroring the back hemisphere into the main beam; aperture integration is only valid over the forward hemisphere, and after the fix the gate reads 0.958 against 0.95

Edge diffraction and the shape error bar (sim_shapeerr.py, reworked after review F3 — the verdict flipped back): the first draft called a 99th-percentile-clipped Sommerfeld integral 'exact' and got 0.077 K = 40% of budget; the review showed that knob swings the answer x15 — the same failure mode this account had criticised in account 8b, in a new shell. The knob-free version splits the physics: boundary energy follows the BEAM onto the scene, not the ground; the ground-facing sector starts at psi_min = 90-za = 19.5 deg (pinned by scan geometry, not chosen) where the integral converges by itself -> 0.0004 K = 0.23% of budget: NEGLIGIBLE after all. The TOTAL diffracted power stays open as a UTD bracket (3.9e-4 to 6.0e-3) and costs Tsys, not calibration; rim rolling/serration drops to belt-and-braces. The shape-error conclusions stand: c from 1-5 mm swings the amplitude by orders while the normalised shape moves at most 0.45; retrieving with the wrong shape splits on the spec (in-spec c>=1.5 mm costs <=0.25% column, a lapped c=1 mm finish costs 5.82%) — the correlation-length spec does two jobs
pois.physics: 高斯波束链:喇叭腰 w0=1.49 mm,-12 dB 边缘锥削照亮 f/D=1.2 的镜沿(23.5°)——锥削压旁瓣、抬主瓣效率,代价是口径效率 0.72;0.74°≈1.18λ/D 就是这笔交易的定价。而远旁瓣的物理与主瓣完全不同:它由表面误差的**空间频率谱**决定——rms 管散射多少、相关长度管散射角宽(Bragg 式 sinθ≈λ/c),所以镜面加工要写两条独立规格
pois.physics_en: Gaussian-beam chain: horn waist w0 = 1.49 mm, -12 dB edge taper illuminating the f/D=1.2 rim at 23.5 deg — taper buys low sidelobes and 0.958 main-beam efficiency at the cost of 0.72 aperture efficiency; 0.74 deg = 1.18 lambda/D is the price tag of that trade. And the far sidelobes obey entirely different physics from the main beam: they are set by the SPATIAL FREQUENCY SPECTRUM of the surface error — rms fixes how much power scatters, correlation length fixes how wide it scatters (Bragg-like, sin(theta) ~ lambda/c) — which is why the mirror drawing carries two independent finish specs

pois.label: 接收机舱(无 LNA 混频优先)
pois.detail: 剖开的舱里是整条超外差链:金色亚谐 Schottky 混频器、铜色 91.655 GHz 本振倍频链(15.276 GHz DRO ×3×2)、上层中频放大与 FFT 频谱仪板。183 GHz 的 LNA 之争正面算过:LNA 优先省 1.5×噪声但引入一颗要熬尘暴热循环的 MMIC——落所无 LNA 直接混频(MHS/ATMS 血统),1.5× 代价用几秒积分买回。电子柜门上的屏就是频谱仪输出:火星的 183 GHz 线只有 37 MHz 宽,比地球窄 81 倍。
pois.detail_en: The cutaway bay holds the whole heterodyne chain: gold subharmonic Schottky mixer, copper 91.655 GHz LO multiplier chain (15.276 GHz DRO x3 x2), IF amp + FFT-spectrometer board above. The 183 GHz LNA fight was fought with numbers: LNA-first saves 1.5x in noise but adds an MMIC that must survive dust-storm thermal cycling — verdict: mixer-first, no LNA (MHS/ATMS heritage), the 1.5x bought back by seconds of integration. The door screen shows the spectrometer output: the martian 183 GHz line is only 37 MHz wide, 81x narrower than Earth's.

sim: 接收机账(sim_receiver.py):级联首轮把转换损耗热噪声与厂商 Tmix 双计算出 1991 K——修正后混频优先 744 K(DSB)正中 MHS 类 600–900 K 遗产区间;火星夜被动冷到 210 K 再赚 12%

通道与反演账(sim_weighting.py,评审后重跑:场景单位 NEΔT+真 ln 导数):γ(z)∝p(z),偏置频率就是高度旋钮;雅可比 SVD 奇异值 318/38/6.9/1.9 → DOF 3.76 = 柱含量+3 层粗廓线(如实声明,不是精细廓线);3 MHz 线心通道是第二轮加的——没有它 20–40 km 层贴着先验不动;柱 0.45%@1 s(历史值 3.63/0.52% 为评审前口径)
灵敏度收官(sim_sensitivity.py):火星水汽是地球千分之一,但线窄 81× 把峰值截面抬 81×、背景是 0.4 K 冷空——10 pr-µm 柱误差 0.45%@1s→0.13%@60s;北半球冬季 1 pr-µm 低值 ~10 s 也进 1%。灵敏度不是问题,绝对标度才是:γ_CO2 展宽系数 ±10% 待一次实验室气室测量退役

LO 频稳账(sim_receiver.py,评审 F4 补):「LO 停线心」是 3 MHz 通道的存在前提。DSB 折叠对 LO 偏移是偶函数——一阶抵消,折叠误差由曲率决定(1 MHz 漂移只折 0.24 K,比单边带斜率 1.55 K/MHz 松一个量级);要求漂移 <0.37 MHz=2 ppm@×12。自由运转 DRO 温漂 1–5 ppm/℃ × 昼夜数十 K=10–100+ ppm,差 1–2 个量级——**DRO 必须锁相 OCXO 基准**(5e-9 级,余量 >400×),真实硬件项
sim_en: Receiver account (sim_receiver.py): the first cascade pass double-counted conversion-loss thermal noise against the vendor Tmix and got 1991 K — corrected, mixer-first lands at 744 K DSB, inside the MHS-class 600-900 K heritage bracket; passive night cooling to 210 K buys another 12%

Channels & retrieval account (sim_weighting.py, rerun post-review with scene-unit NEDT and true ln derivatives): gamma(z) ~ p(z), so frequency offset IS the altitude knob; Jacobian SVD singular values 318/38/6.9/1.9 -> DOF 3.76 = column + 3-layer coarse profile (declared honestly — not a fine profile); the 3 MHz core channel was added in round two — without it the 20-40 km layer sat at prior; column 0.45% @1 s (the historical 3.63 / 0.52% were pre-review conventions)

Sensitivity closure (sim_sensitivity.py): Mars carries 1/1000 of Earth's vapor, but the 81x narrower line piles the same molecules 81x higher in peak cross-section, seen against a 0.4 K sky — 10 pr-um column to 0.45% @1s, 0.13% @60s; even the 1 pr-um northern-winter low reaches 1% in ~10 s. Sensitivity is not the problem; absolute scale is: the gamma_CO2 broadening coefficient carries ±10% until one lab gas-cell measurement retires it

LO stability account (sim_receiver.py, added per review F4): 'LO parked on line centre' is what the 3 MHz channel's existence rests on. DSB folding is EVEN in LO offset — first order cancels, and the folded error is curvature-limited (1 MHz of drift folds to just 0.24 K, an order softer than the 1.55 K/MHz single-sideband slope); the requirement is drift < 0.37 MHz = 2 ppm at x12. A free-running DRO drifts 1-5 ppm/degC times tens of kelvin per sol = 10-100+ ppm — off by one to two orders. The DRO must be phase-locked to an OCXO reference (5e-9 class, >400x margin): a real hardware item
pois.physics: 压致展宽 γ∝p:6.1 hPa 的 CO₂ 把地球 3.02 GHz 的线压到 37 MHz——通道全塞在 ±300 MHz 内,地球同类仪器摆 ±7 GHz;线心到 59 km 高度以上才轮到多普勒(224 kHz)接管。DSB 折叠无惩罚是对称线的独有便宜:两个边带载着同一条线,ALMA WVR 同法
pois.physics_en: Pressure broadening gamma ~ p: 6.1 hPa of CO2 squeezes Earth's 3.02 GHz line to 37 MHz — all channels fit inside ±300 MHz where terrestrial sounders spread over ±7 GHz; Doppler (224 kHz) only takes over above 59 km. The free lunch of DSB folding is unique to a symmetric line: both sidebands carry the same channel, as on the ALMA WVR

pois.label: 地面定标黑体(两点定标热端)
pois.detail: 摆镜鼓正下方的敞口箱:锥形吸波阵(尖劈让入射波多次反射逐次吸收,发射率 0.999)坐在铜加热背板上,PT100 温度已知到 ±0.2 K——这是两点定标的『热端』;『冷端』不是液氮,是 1.5 GHz 窗口通道里的天顶冷空(模型 0.4–0.9 K):火星大气在远翼几乎透明,直接看到微波背景。每轮 30 s 扫描定标一次,压住增益漂移。
pois.detail_en: The open box right under the drum: a pyramidal absorber array (wedges trap the wave through multiple bounces, emissivity 0.999) on a copper heater backplate, PT100-known to ±0.2 K — the HOT point of the two-point calibration. The COLD point is not liquid nitrogen but the zenith sky in the 1.5 GHz window channel (model 0.4-0.9 K): in the far wing the martian atmosphere is nearly transparent, straight through to the microwave background. Calibration every 30-s scan pins the gain drift.

specs.冷端: 窗口通道天顶冷空,审计值 0.470 K(季节 0.403–0.938)

sim: 定标账(sim_receiver.py):两点内插到线心场景(~190 K)的绝对不确定度 0.19 K——热端 ±0.2 K 与冷端 ±0.5 K 各按杠杆比传播;增益稳定性 1e-4 假设由 30 s 两点节奏保住,对应积分曲线 0.12% 的柱精度平台

冷端透明度审计(sim_window.py,评审后 O₂ 修正):整条定标链压在「窗口通道 0.4–0.9 K」上——CMB 362.9 mK(77%)+ H₂O 远翼 81.6 + 尘 24.8 + CO₂ 碰撞诱导 0.023 + O₂ 118 GHz 翼 0.002 = **0.469 K**,季节 0.402–0.938 K 恰落假设带内,0.19 K 定标不变。空结果本身就是结论——它授权拿天空当定标标准

方法修正三连(评审 F6/F13):O₂ 首轮编常数得 τ=7.79(荒谬)→ 地球锚定重做;评审又抓出重做版代码只乘了一个 p 而注释文档全称 vmr·p²(差 83×,保守向)——已补第二个 p 与 p² 吸收体的 H/2 标高。另一条必做声明:**定标软件对黑体用瑞利-金斯等效亮温**——t_RJ(230 K)@183 GHz=225.6 K,那 −4.4 K 是换算不是误差(与场景、冷端同一亮温轴才能内插),PT100 ±0.2 K 仍是不确定度主项
sim_en: Calibration account (sim_receiver.py): two-point interpolation to the ~190 K line-center scene carries 0.19 K absolute — hot ±0.2 K and cold ±0.5 K each propagated by lever ratio; the 1e-4 gain-stability assumption is earned by the 30-s cadence and maps to the 0.12% column-precision plateau

Cold-reference transparency audit (sim_window.py, O2 corrected post-review): the whole chain rests on 'the window channel sees 0.4-0.9 K' — CMB 362.9 mK (77%) + H2O far wing 81.6 + dust 24.8 + CO2 collision-induced 0.023 + O2 118 GHz wing 0.002 = 0.469 K, seasonal 0.402-0.938 K, inside the assumed band; the 0.19 K figure stands. The null result IS the finding — it licenses the sky as a calibration standard

Three method fixes (review F6/F13): the O2 term first used an invented constant (tau = 7.79, absurd) and was redone by Earth anchoring; the review then caught the redone CODE multiplying only one factor of p while comment, README and card all said vmr x p^2 (83x, conservative direction) — the second p and the H/2 scale height of a p^2 absorber are now in. And one mandatory declaration: the calibration software uses the RAYLEIGH-JEANS equivalent brightness of the hot load — t_RJ(230 K) at 183 GHz is 225.6 K, and that -4.4 K is a conversion, not an error (hot, scene and cold must sit on the same brightness axis to interpolate); the PT100's +/-0.2 K remains the dominant uncertainty
pois.physics: 辐射计方程 ΔT=Tsys/√(Bτ) 只管随机噪声,长积分的真敌人是增益漂移——两点定标把系统响应线(斜率+截距)每 30 s 重画一次;火星送的便宜:670 K 系统对 ~190 K 场景,冷空冷端天然免费,不用背液氮上火星
pois.physics_en: The radiometer equation dT = Tsys/sqrt(B tau) covers only random noise; the real enemy of long integration is gain drift — two-point calibration redraws the response line (slope + intercept) every 30 s. Mars' gift: against the ~190 K scene of a 670 K system, the cold-sky reference is free — no liquid nitrogen shipped to Mars

pois.label: 镜面防霜(仪器与自己测的量)
pois.label_en: Mirror Anti-Frost (the instrument vs its own measurand)
pois.detail: 这台仪器测水汽,而同一批水汽会在它自己的 45° 镜面上凝成霜——设计上最自指的一环。抛光铝镜的红外发射率只有 0.05,这不只是「反射好」:它让镜面在夜里只比气温低 0.22 K,而裸地(发射率 0.95、全天空视场)要低 4.12 K——**低发射率本身就是主动防霜措施**,水汽优先落在地面而不是光学件上。剩下那 0.22 K 过冷用 1.15 W 加热片清零,是全站最便宜的生存项。
pois.detail_en: This instrument measures water vapor, and that same vapor plates out as frost on its own 45-deg mirror — the most self-referential item in the design. The polished aluminium mirror's IR emissivity of 0.05 is not merely good reflectivity: it keeps the mirror only 0.22 K below air temperature at night, where bare regolith (emissivity 0.95, full sky view) sits 4.12 K below. Low emissivity IS an active anti-frost measure — vapor prefers the ground to the optics. The remaining 0.22 K of sub-cooling is erased by a 1.15 W heater foil, the cheapest survival item on the station.

specs.夜耗: 14 Wh = 气象站 WEB 的 4%

specs_en.Deposition bound: 6.4 um/h (4.7% of a wavelength per night)

sim: 结霜账两次修正(sim_mech_frost.py):首轮固定混合比算出 10 pr-µm 霜点 196.3 K 对 190 K 夜、判「镜面结霜」——但那同时意味着大气自己过饱和,不可能;火星水汽夜间凝结析出(Viking 拍到地表霜),近地面 vmr 被钳在饱和值,10 pr-µm 白天水汽的近地面分压被钳低 64.6%(局地钳制比,不是列柱析出份额——评审 F9 修正措辞)
第二轮又搞反:问题不是「镜面是否低于霜点」(饱和大气里所有面都低于),而是「谁最冷」。裸地 ε=0.95 全天空视场过冷 4.12 K,镜面 ε=0.05 缝内遮挡只过冷 0.22 K——镜面反而是最不冷的面之一,这解释了为什么 Viking 拍到的是地表霜不是设备霜
沉积率(Hertz-Knudsen 上界 6.39 µm/h,整夜 76.7 µm=4.7% 波长,光学无害但逐 sol 累积且此温度下不升华)对局地供应限(10 m 层只够 0.0075 µm):真值由平流补给决定夹在两界之间,地面拿走大部分。首轮把根号写反得 1e26 µm/h,是量级常识抓出来的
sim_en: Frost account, corrected twice (sim_mech_frost.py): the first pass held the mixing ratio fixed, found a 196.3 K frost point against a 190 K night and declared the mirror frosts — but that also says the ATMOSPHERE is supersaturated, which is impossible; martian vapor condenses out overnight (Viking imaged surface frost) and near-surface vmr is clamped to saturation, with the NEAR-SURFACE partial pressure clamped 64.6% below its daytime value (a local clamp, not a column-condensation fraction — wording fixed per review F9)

The second pass had it backwards too: the question is not 'is the mirror below the frost point' (in a saturated atmosphere everything is) but 'which surface is coldest'. Bare ground at emissivity 0.95 with a full sky view sub-cools 4.12 K; the mirror at 0.05 behind a slot only 0.22 K — the optic is among the LEAST cold surfaces, which is exactly why Viking imaged frost on the ground and not on hardware

Deposition: Hertz-Knudsen upper bound 6.39 um/h (76.7 um per night = 4.7% of a wavelength — optically harmless but it accumulates sol after sol and never sublimes at these temperatures) against a local supply limit of 0.0075 um from a 10 m layer; the truth is set by advective resupply between those bounds, and the ground takes most of it. The first pass inverted the root and returned 1e26 um/h — caught by an order-of-magnitude sanity check, not by re-derivation
pois.physics: 冰面饱和蒸汽压 log₁₀p = −2663.5/T + 12.537(Marti-Mauersberger)随温度指数陡变,190 K 的空气只装得下 0.033 Pa 水汽——所以火星的水「日出蒸发、日落落霜」,昼夜循环本身就是一台冷凝泵;而辐射冷却让每个面按自己的发射率与天空视场因子决定过冷深度,冷阱之争由 ε·F_sky 排序,不由材料贵贱排序
pois.physics_en: Ice saturation pressure log10 p = -2663.5/T + 12.537 (Marti-Mauersberger) is exponentially steep, so 190 K air holds only 0.033 Pa of vapor — martian water evaporates at sunrise and falls as frost at sunset, the diurnal cycle itself being a condensation pump. Radiative cooling then sets each surface's sub-cooling by its own emissivity and sky view factor: the competition for cold-trap status is ranked by eps x F_sky, not by how precious the hardware is

pois.label: 城联动:尘暴接棒(与气象站互赖)
pois.label_en: City Hook: Storm Handover (with the met station)
pois.detail: 电缆桥架通向东北 11 m 外的气象站(sci-weather-01),两台仪器在尘暴里互相接棒:光度计 τ>3 时直射透过率只剩 2.7%、光学链全瞎,而尘对 183 GHz 近乎透明(τ_vis=5 时 τ_183≈1e-3)——本机照常供水汽;反过来,尘暴加热中层大气 +25 K 会让盲反演偏 +3.8%,吃进气象站地面温度+GCM 把 T(z) 收到 ±5 K 后压到 +0.8%。绿灯=链路正常,琥珀闪=尘暴模式(与气象站设备舱同一预警源)。水汽数据同时供 ISRU:Rodwell 采水与推进剂厂的大气侧账。
pois.detail_en: The cable tray runs 11 m northeast to the met station (sci-weather-01); in a dust storm the two instruments hand the baton back and forth: at tau>3 the sun photometer's direct beam drops to 2.7% and the optical chain goes blind, while dust is nearly transparent at 183 GHz (tau_183 ~ 1e-3 at tau_vis=5) — this radiometer keeps the vapor record running. In return, storm heating of the middle atmosphere (+25 K) would bias a blind retrieval by +3.8%; ingesting the met station's surface T plus GCM tightens T(z) to ±5 K and cuts the bias to +0.8%. Green lamp = link OK, amber flash = storm mode (same alert source as the met station's cabin). The vapor record also feeds ISRU: the atmospheric side of the Rodwell and propellant-plant ledgers.

specs.互引: sci-weather-01 光度计卡(τ>3)/设备舱卡(预警灯)
specs.气压互赖: p0 由气象站气压计供给(CO₂ 季节循环 ±10–15%;固定 610 Pa 反演 +10% 偏柱 −2.5%,实测后归零)
specs.掩星互赖(登记): com-polar-01 星间掩星温压廓线:**原登记的 20–40 km 交叉验证已撤销**——我方理由串了量(以水汽平均核论证温度约束),且其 σ_T 在该带 4.0–25.1 K、可用带止于 22 km;改按其强项 0–20 km 重新登记(σ_T 0.8–1.7 K @0–10 km),待代表性核定。先验主源仍是气象站+GCM
specs.轨道器掩星(第二 T(z) 源): sci-orbiter-01:0–60 km、σ_T 1.1 K(仅 <40 km 静稳;40–60 km ~3 K、尘暴 ~4 K)、63 廓线/sol,但沿射线加权 σ=194 km(出品方已声明口径,原「300–550 km」作废)→ 20 km 以下代表性误差 1.9–3.3 K,仍主导但仅 1.7–3.0×(**原报 4.1–7.3 K 偏大 2.2×,系我方误读口径,已更正**);与气象站误差机制独立,合并在 K 尺度上从不变差(3.3–4.8 K)。**柱项增益 5–12%,原报「约 30%」已撤回**——那个数把账 9 的累计闭环偏差减去了一个局部线性 T(z) 单项(两把尺);同尺重算后气象站单独 +3.77%,合并 +3.35%~+3.72%,区间宽度来自已撤回的尘暴代表性因子(见 review/check_storm_factor.py);因子待在轨裁决(相邻切点互差统计 / 底边界对气象站 p₀T₀ 残差)
specs.足印代表性(供引用): **城址预算:无——保留中**(09-03 的 3.59 K 与 09-02 的 2.22 K 均已撤回,裁定 4 待 com-gap 按设计槽重跑的逐次 d 分布)。可引的只有结构:**区域角色**(地形行 L,切点当地)com-polar-01 1.23/1.20/1.16 K @0/10/20 km、sci-orbiter-01 1.21 K,两台都不过 2×;**城址角色**只在切点近城址的掠过上存在(行 C,d 待定),2000 km 外的掠过与城址比不是地形问题、本表不覆盖(行 X)

specs_en.Cross-ref: sci-weather-01 photometer card (tau>3) / cabin card (alert lamp)
specs_en.Storm degradation: blind +12.05% (36% non-convergent) -> +3.89% with met T(z), a 3.1x gain (closed-loop; the linear estimate reads +3.6% -> +0.7%)
specs_en.Pressure hook: p0 from the met-station barometer (CO2 cycle swings it 10-15%; a fixed-610-Pa retrieval takes -2.5% per +10%, measured p0 zeroes it)
specs_en.Occultation link (registered): com-polar-01 inter-satellite occultation T/p profiles: THE 20-40 km CROSS-CHECK REGISTRATION IS WITHDRAWN - our justification confused quantities (arguing a temperature constraint from a water averaging kernel), and their sigma_T there is 4.0-25.1 K with the usable band ending at 22 km. Re-registered at 0-20 km, their real strength (sigma_T 0.8-1.7 K over 0-10 km), pending a representativeness check. The met station + GCM remain the primary prior
specs_en.Orbiter RO (second T(z) source): sci-orbiter-01: 0-60 km, sigma_T 1.1 K (below 40 km in calm conditions only; ~3 K at 40-60 km, ~4 K in a storm), 63 profiles/sol, but an along-ray Gaussian weighting of sigma = 194 km (convention since declared by its producer; the 300-550 km figure retired) -> representativeness 1.9-3.3 K, still dominant but only by 1.7-3.0x (WE FIRST PUBLISHED 4.1-7.3 K, 2.2x too large, from misreading the convention; corrected) below 20 km; its error mechanism is independent of the met chain and combining never makes things worse in Kelvin (3.3-4.8 K). THE COLUMN GAIN IS 5-12%; THE "~30%" WE FIRST REPORTED IS WITHDRAWN - it subtracted account 9's CUMULATIVE closed-loop bias from a local linear T(z)-only estimate, two different rulers. Recomputed on one ruler the met chain alone is +3.77% and the combination +3.35% to +3.72%, the width coming from a storm representativeness factor we have withdrawn (see review/check_storm_factor.py); the factor awaits in-orbit adjudication (neighbouring-tangent-point difference statistics / lower-boundary residuals against the met station p0,T0)
specs_en.Footprint representativeness (citable): CITY BUDGET: NONE - ON HOLD (the 3.59 K of 09-03 and the 2.22 K of 09-02 are withdrawn; ruling 4 waits for com-gap's pass-by-pass d under the design slots). Citable is the structure only: REGIONAL role (terrain row L, at the locus) com-polar-01 1.23/1.20/1.16 K at 0/10/20 km and sci-orbiter-01 1.21 K, neither over 2x; CITY role exists only on passes whose tangent point nears the city (row C, d pending); a pass 2000 km away compared against the city is not a terrain question and is outside this table (row X)

sim: 尘暴退化账(sim_sensitivity.py):r_eff=1.5 µm 玄武尘在 1.64 mm 波长深处 Rayleigh 区,Q_abs∝2πr/λ → τ_vis=5 折到 183 GHz 只剩 ~1e-3;真正的退化项是温度廓线——把尘暴加热(+25 K@5–30 km,地面 −10 K)喂进正演、反演仍用平静廓线:柱偏 +3.8%;T(z) 收到 ±5 K 后 +0.8%。这就是联动卡的账:光学瞎了它顶上,它的偏差靠气象站压住

最优估计闭环账(sim_oem.py,评审后重跑):①迭代不可省——一次线性化在远离先验真态上偏 +19.44%,迭代 OEM −0.24%;②真平均核 DOF 3.21(线性 SVD 3.76),对角元 1.00/0.91/0.88 是真测量而 20–40 km 仅 0.43=57% 先验,该层作受约束上界发布;③推翻一条:未扣 1.49 K 地面拾取让反演**全部发散**(窗口通道仅 0.4 K 信号),接 140° 地面停位扣到 10% 后 +2.85% 且良态——停位是可用/不可用分界;④尘暴盲 +12.05%(36% 不收敛)接气象站后 +3.89%=**3.1× 改善**(账 5 线性估计 ~5×,闭环为准——评审 F11 抓出旧文硬编码 5x);⑤解析误差棒 0.34% 低估蒙卡 0.90% 约 3×,对外用蒙卡数

地面停位标定精度专账(sim_groundcal.py):账9 让"扣到 10% 残差"承担了可用/不可用的分界,故这条假设必须自己有账。**陷阱**:sci-ir-01 测的 8–14 µm 表皮温度**不是** 183 GHz 看到的温度——毫米波穿透 1.1 cm 与昼夜热趋肤深度 3.8 cm 同量级,毫米波亮温是深度加权的热波:振幅只有表面的 0.76、相位滞后 0.9 火星小时,直接拿红外读数当地面亮温整日最大偏 18 K。解法不加硬件:把停位排在两条曲线交叉的 LTST 4.6 h,±0.5 h 调度漂移只花 2.3 K。**账8a 的说法被修正**:2 m 处地面深在 27.5 m 夫琅禾费距离之内,近场没有远场方向图——这个停位测的是地面**亮温**(口径投影 0.17 m 全落地面,读数干净),不是远场旁瓣耦合系数。精度需求反推:耦合份额 f=0.0075,要守住 0.149 K 残差需地面亮温知道到 20 K;实际可得 5.8 K(发射率 0.92±0.03 给 5.3 K + 调度残差 2.3 K)→ **余量 3.4×,账9 的假设成立**。而耦合系数本身可由数据自解:把它加进 OEM 状态向量后后验 1σ 0.014(先验 0.5)、DOF 1.00、与各水汽层最大相关仅 0.18——**通道维度做到了天顶角维度做不到的分离**(账8a 的 tipping 相关 0.87 失败):宽带地面项给六个通道加同样的亮温,而水汽在线心加 190 K、在窗口只加 0.4 K,这个谱特征就是解简并的钥匙

com-polar-01 掩星副产品互引(登记性质,核实见 out/occultation_xref.json)——总控转来的口径是「温压剖面做先验/交叉验证点,两者高度覆盖互补」,按我方平均核与温度雅可比核过之后**互补成立、但「先验」那半句要收窄**:①水汽侧确实不重不抢——我方六通道的水汽信号只有 ≤3.51% 来自掩星段,测量对象在那一段几乎为空。**该段已由出品方收窄为 20–40 km,我方按新域重积:两个数一位不变**——但不变的原因不是被切掉那片小,而是**我方宁静廓线的 hygropause 在 25 km,30 km 以上每一层的份额都恰好是 0.00%**,两个波段积的是同一块东西。**因此必须随数附上工况**:那个零是宁静廓线的性质,而尘暴会把水汽抬到远高于宁静 hygropause 的高度——抬到 60 km 时该份额变成 7.24%(2.1×)、温度敏感度份额从 4.2% 变成 7.4%(1.8×)。结论仍成立,但余量近乎减半,而且恰好减在这个接口最要紧的工况上(核实 review/narrow_band_20_40.py);②但 T(z) 是我方前向模型的**输入**,而按噪声加权的温度敏感度 **95.8% 落在 20 km 以下**、掩星段只占 **4.2%**——掩星替代不了 sci-weather-01 + GCM 作为 T(z) 先验主源(账 9:尘暴盲 +12.05% → 接气象站 +3.89%,那笔改善来自低层);③真正有价值的是 **20–40 km 重叠带**:那恰是我方最弱的水汽层(平均核对角元 0.43,账 9 已声明按「受约束上界」发布)。**这个 0.43 有两条限定,都是核对方推论时才发现的**:(i)**它是一次抽样不是常数**——平均核在含噪反演的线性化点上算,120 次系综给 0.52±0.08,0.43 落在低端;"该层受先验主导"这个承重结论不动,但 0.43 不该当设计常数引用。(ii)**它是宁静廓线的数,而工况比抽样更要紧**:尘暴把水汽抬进这一带后对角元升到 0.82±0.03——**那时我方自己就测得动这层,外部交叉验证反而更不被需要**,与"尘暴期最需要它"的直觉相反(核实 review/ak_under_lofting.py)。**④ 但这条登记已被我方撤销,而先倒下的是我方自己的理由**(核实 review/recheck_compolar_role.py)。我们当初的说法是"该层平均核最弱,外部约束余地最大"——**可掩星给的是温度,我方那个平均核是水汽的**;T 在我方前向模型里是**固定输入**,不是与水汽对换的被反演量,所以 T 知道得更准**不会把那个对角元抬高分毫**。这是量的串位,**与对方的数无关,是我方的错**;对方刚在反方向纠正过同型错误(不拿我方判据顶替其敏感度峰),我却没看出自己反着犯了一遍。**可测的那条通道则被实测否掉**:出品方现已开出掩星敏感度账(预注册先于计算,且自记预测落点错了)——σ_T 在 20/30/40 km 为 3.96/9.3/25.1 K,可用带只到 22 km,我方登记的 20 km 带只有 2 km(10%)落在其可用范围内;把其 σ 注入账 9 闭环,柱项移动**小于我方自身的蒙卡噪声**。**改判**:撤销 20–40 km 交叉验证登记,改按其真实强项 **0–20 km** 重新登记(σ_T 在 0–10 km 为 0.8/1.74 K,而我方 95.8% 的温度敏感度正在此段——这正是当初"止步 20 km 故不能用"的否决理由所指的地方,而这一源并不止步于此);新登记须过**代表性**那一关——**已过,用的是它自己的足印**:出品方交来 G7 沿射线加权,三分位反解 σ=197→184 km(0→20 km),对我方 1 km 高度 0.013 km 足印,给出静稳 1.89→1.76 K。**此处原文曾写「沿射线 300–550 km 平均」,是双重错误已更正**:那个数(a)口径未声明、现已作废,(b)**是 sci-orbiter-01 的足印,被我方套到了 com-polar-01 头上**——正是我方请 com-gap 不要做的那件事,我在写它的那一段里自己做了。完整两表见本卡末条。那一项任何 σ 都答不了,也是真正定其价值的东西。零新硬件,不展开成账。

sci-orbiter-01 无线电掩星互引(与 com-polar-01 星间掩星是两套仪器;核实见 out/orbiter_ro_xref.json)——**上一条的否决理由在这里失效,须重判**:星间源止步 20 km 而我方 95.8% 温度敏感度在其下,这一源直抵 0 km,所以改按**代表性**而非覆盖或精度重新论证。①**足印而非仪器决定误差**:我方波束在 1 km 高度足印仅 0.013 km、za=70.5° 阶梯最多横移 56 km,而掩星是沿射线的高斯加权平均,σ=194 km(出品方后来声明的口径,宽约 3.5×);该跨度在 18.4°N 相当于 **14 min 地方时**加地形起伏,给出 **1.9–3.3 K 代表性误差 = 声称 σ_T 1.1 K 的 1.7–3.0×**。**此处我方原报 4.1–7.3 K / 3.7–6.6×,偏大 2.2 倍,已更正**:出品方那时只给「足印 300–550 km」而未声明口径,我方**假设**它是沿轨跨度并取其均值 425 km;其后出品方声明该量是沿射线高斯加权的 **σ=194 km**(半宽 131/249/381 km、1/e 全宽 549 km),而高斯的均方根位移就是 σ 本身——算式没错,输入的含义不是那个。更正后足印仍大于仪器项但**两者已是同一量级**,故"那个优秀的 σ 花不到最想花的地方"这句话**收回**:σ 是被削弱,不是被浪费。②**但这不等于比我方现有链差**:4.2 K(宁静)–7.3 K(晨昏)对气象站链的 5.0 K 尘暴残差,量级相当;我方**拒绝排名**,因为两者误差机制独立(水平平均 vs 模式廓线形状),且我方并不拥有气象站链在宁静期的误差账,没有可比基准。③**因此不是二选一而是合并——但这一条我们报错了两次,已撤回重算**。合并本身成立:误差机制独立可正交合并,尘暴工况 4.5–16.7 K ⊕ 5.0 K = 3.3–4.8 K,**在 K 尺度上从不变差**(这是反方差算术,不是假设)。错的是它值多少:(a)我们曾声明尘暴代表性因子 0.5(尘混合抹平水平结构),而出品方自己的球对称项 1.1→4.2 K 是**同一物理反向走 3.8×**。出品方随后交底:其 4.2 K 由 `storm_frac=2%` 这一档类假设给出,**同样不是实测或推导**——所以那 3.8× 并不构成对我方 0.5 的反证,只是另一个假设指向反面。**两边对称地定不了**,故因子撤回、改为 0.5–4.0 全扫,区间不偏袒任何一端。真正能裁决它的是在轨数据(出品方提出、均为掩星副产品、不加硬件):①尘暴期同一 sol 内相邻切点(间距约百 km)廓线互差的统计,直接给出沿线水平结构幅度;②尘暴期掩星底边界与气象站 p₀/T₀ 残差的时间序列。到数之前 2–11% 为冻结口径;(b)更要命的是**两把尺相减**:原报「+3.89%→+2.74%,改善约 30%」里的 +3.89% 是账 9 的**累计**闭环偏差(含噪声+0.19 K 定标+0.15 K 地面停位),+2.74% 却是核实脚本自己的**四层线性 T(z) 单项**;两条尺恰在 4.77 K 交叉,这个巧合把表面自洽伪装了出来。改法:不再估柱项,**每一格都重跑账 9 闭环**(含气象站单独那一格,600 次试验,与冻结值差 0.116 pp、在 0.482 pp 蒙卡容差内)。结果:气象站单独 +3.77%,合并 +3.35%(因子 0.5)到 +3.72%(因子 4.0),**增益 5–12% 而非 30%**;即便按我们自己那个已撤回的 0.5,诚实值也只有 11.3%——原来那 30% 里大半是换尺换出来的。在出品方隐含的 3.8× 下增益仅 1.7%,低于两倍标准误,**不显著**。**采纳为 20 km 以下的第二等价 T(z) 源(非替代主源)**,另加三个角色:20–40 km 独立交叉验证(我方平均核仅 0.43,外部约束余地最大)、GCM/先验模式的验证者(63 廓线/sol 全球——比当任何单次反演的先验更耐久)、地面 p0/T0 对核(服务评审 F5 气压接口)。出品方自提的「足印在 20–40 km 无碍」经核**与我方冻结的 AK 0.43 自洽**:该高度大气不与地形耦合,σ=194 km 量级的沿线平均在那里确实有代表性——两句话是同一事实的两面。

sim_en: Storm degradation account (sim_sensitivity.py): 1.5-um basaltic dust sits deep in the Rayleigh regime at 1.64 mm, Q_abs ~ 2pi r/lambda, so tau_vis=5 folds to ~1e-3 at 183 GHz; the real degradation is the temperature profile — feeding storm heating (+25 K at 5-30 km, -10 K at the surface) into the forward model while retrieving with the calm profile biases the column +3.8%; tightening T(z) to ±5 K cuts it to +0.8%. That is the linkage ledger: when optics go blind this instrument takes over, and the met station holds down its bias

Optimal-estimation closed loop (sim_oem.py, rerun post-review): (1) iteration is not optional — one-shot linearisation errs +19.44% far from prior vs -0.24% iterated; (2) true kernel DOF 3.21 (linear SVD 3.76), diagonals 1.00/0.91/0.88 genuinely measured while 20-40 km sits at 0.43 = 57% prior, published as a constrained upper bound; (3) one finding overturned: an uncorrected 1.49 K ground pickup makes every retrieval DIVERGE (the window channel holds just 0.4 K of signal); with the 140-deg ground stop trimming it to 10% the cost is +2.85% and well-behaved — the stop is the usable/unusable line; (4) storm-blind +12.05% (36% non-convergent) drops to +3.89% with the met link = a 3.1x gain (account 5's linear ~5x superseded; review F11 caught the hard-coded '5x'); (5) the analytic error bar (0.34%) understates Monte-Carlo scatter (0.90%) by ~3x — publish the MC number

Ground-stop calibration account (sim_groundcal.py): account 9 made "corrected to 10% residual" carry the line between a usable and an unusable instrument, so that assumption needed its own ledger. THE TRAP: the 8-14 um skin temperature sci-ir-01 measures is NOT the temperature the 183 GHz radiometer sees — microwave penetration (1.1 cm) is comparable to the diurnal thermal skin depth (3.8 cm), so the millimetre brightness is a depth-weighted thermal wave damped to 0.76 of the surface amplitude and lagging 0.9 martian hours; taking the IR reading at face value errs by up to 18 K over a sol. The fix needs no hardware: schedule the stop at LTST 4.6 h where the two curves cross, where a +/-0.5 h slip costs only 2.3 K. ACCOUNT 8A CORRECTED: at 2 m the ground sits far inside the 27.5 m Fraunhofer distance, and a near-field stare has no far-field pattern — this stop measures ground BRIGHTNESS (the 0.17 m aperture projection lands entirely on ground, giving a clean reading), not the far-field sidelobe coupling. Requirement back-out: with coupling fraction f = 0.0075, holding the 0.149 K residual needs ground brightness known to 20 K; 5.8 K is achievable (emissivity 0.92+/-0.03 gives 5.3 K, scheduling residual 2.3 K) — a 3.4x margin, so account 9's assumption stands. The coupling itself is then retrievable from the data: added to the OEM state vector it comes back with posterior 1-sigma 0.014 against a 0.5 prior, DOF 1.00, and at most 0.18 correlation with any water layer — the CHANNEL dimension achieves what the zenith-angle dimension could not (account 8a's tipping correlation of 0.87). A broadband ground term adds the same brightness to all six channels while water adds 190 K at line centre and 0.4 K in the window, and that spectral signature is the key that breaks the degeneracy

com-polar-01 occultation by-product cross-reference (registered, verification in out/occultation_xref.json). The overseer forwarded it as "T/p profiles serve as prior / cross-validation points, the two height coverages being complementary". Checked against our own averaging kernels and temperature Jacobian, the complementarity holds but the "prior" half has to be narrowed: (1) on the water side there is genuinely no overlap or competition — at most 3.51% of any channel's water signal originates in the occultation band, which is essentially empty of our measurand. THE BAND HAS SINCE BEEN NARROWED to 20-40 km by its producer and we reintegrated on the new one: both figures are unchanged to every published digit — but not because the removed slice was small. Our calm profile puts the hygropause at 25 km and every slab from 30 km up carries exactly 0.00% of both quantities, so the two bands integrate the same thing. THE REGIME THEREFORE HAS TO TRAVEL WITH THE NUMBER: that zero is a property of the calm profile, and dust storms loft water far above the calm hygropause. Raised to 60 km, the water share becomes 7.24% (2.1x) and the temperature share goes from 4.2% to 7.4% (1.8x). Both conclusions still hold, but the margin roughly halves — and it halves precisely in the regime where this interface matters most (verification in review/narrow_band_20_40.py); (2) T(z) however enters our forward model as an INPUT, and 95.8% of our noise-weighted temperature sensitivity sits BELOW 20 km against only 4.2% inside the occultation band — so the occultation cannot replace sci-weather-01 + GCM as the primary T(z) prior (account 9: storm-blind +12.05% improves to +3.89% with the met link, and that gain comes from the low layers); (3) what is genuinely valuable is the 20-40 km OVERLAP, which is precisely our weakest water layer (averaging-kernel diagonal 0.43, already published as a constrained upper bound per account 9). THAT 0.43 CARRIES TWO QUALIFICATIONS, both found only when checking a downstream inference drawn from it: (i) it is ONE DRAW, not a constant - the kernel is evaluated at the state retrieved from a noisy observation, and over 120 draws the calm value is 0.52+/-0.08 with 0.43 at the low end; the load-bearing claim (that layer is prior-dominated) stands, but 0.43 should not be quoted as a design constant. (ii) It is a CALM-PROFILE number, and regime outweighs draw: with water lofted into the band the diagonal rises to 0.82+/-0.03, meaning that in a storm we largely measure the layer ourselves and the external cross-check is needed there LESS, not more - the opposite of the intuition that a storm is when it matters most (verification in review/ak_under_lofting.py) — (4) THAT REGISTRATION HAS SINCE BEEN WITHDRAWN BY US, and the first thing to fall was our own reason (verification in review/recheck_compolar_role.py). We justified the band by our weakest averaging kernel - but an occultation supplies TEMPERATURE while that kernel is a WATER kernel: T enters our forward model as a fixed input, not as a quantity the water retrieval trades against, so knowing T better raises that diagonal by nothing at all. That is a category error, it is ours, and it holds independently of their numbers; they had just corrected the same confusion in the opposite direction (declining to let our criterion stand in for their sensitivity peak) while we failed to see we had made it in reverse. THE MEASURABLE CHANNEL WAS THEN TESTED AND FAILED TOO: their new sensitivity account (pre-registered before computing, with its own mispredicted peak recorded) puts sigma_T at 3.96 / 9.3 / 25.1 K at 20 / 30 / 40 km and usable only to 22 km, so just 2 km (10%) of the band we registered lies inside their usable range; injected into account 9 closed loop, that sigma moves our column by less than our own Monte-Carlo noise. RE-REGISTERED at 0-20 km instead, their real strength (sigma_T 0.8 / 1.74 K at 0 / 10 km), which is where 95.8% of our temperature sensitivity sits - the very region the earlier "it stops at 20 km" rejection was about, and this source does not stop there. The new registration had still to pass the REPRESENTATIVENESS test, AND HAS PASSED IT, on its own footprint: com-gap supplied the G7 along-ray weighting, whose quantiles back out sigma = 197 to 184 km over 0-20 km, and against our 0.013 km footprint at 1 km altitude that gives 1.89 to 1.76 K in quiet hours. THIS CLAUSE PREVIOUSLY READ 'a 300-550 km along-ray average' AND WAS WRONG TWICE OVER: that figure (a) had no stated convention and has since been retired, and (b) IS sci-orbiter-01's footprint, which we applied to com-polar-01 - precisely the cross-instrument substitution we had asked com-gap not to make, made by us, inside the paragraph about com-polar-01. Both tables are in the last entry of this card. That term is what actually decides the interface's worth, and no sigma can answer it. No new hardware; not expanded into an account.

sci-orbiter-01 radio-occultation cross-reference (a different instrument from the com-polar-01 inter-satellite occultation; verification in out/orbiter_ro_xref.json). THE PREVIOUS REJECTION NO LONGER APPLIES and the question was re-decided: the star-link source stopped at 20 km while 95.8% of our temperature sensitivity lies below it, whereas this one reaches 0 km — so the argument moved from coverage and precision to REPRESENTATIVENESS. (1) The footprint, not the instrument, sets the error: our beam footprint at 1 km altitude is 0.013 km and the za=70.5 ladder displaces the ray at most 56 km, while an occultation profile is a Gaussian along-ray average of sigma = 194 km (the convention its producer later declared), about 3.5x wider. At 18.4 N that span is 14 minutes of local time plus terrain relief, giving 1.9-3.3 K of representativeness error - 1.7-3.0x the declared 1.1 K sigma. WE FIRST PUBLISHED 4.1-7.3 K AND 3.7-6.6x, TOO LARGE BY 2.2x, AND HAVE CORRECTED IT: at the time its producer quoted only "300-550 km footprint" with no stated convention, and we ASSUMED an along-track span and took its mean, 425 km. The producer has since declared the quantity to be a Gaussian along-ray weighting with sigma = 194 km (half-widths 131/249/381 km, 1/e full width 549 km), and the RMS displacement of a Gaussian is sigma itself - the arithmetic was right, the input meant something else. Corrected, the footprint still exceeds the instrument term but the two are now the SAME ORDER, so we withdraw "the excellent sigma cannot be spent where we would most want it": it is degraded, not wasted. (2) That does NOT put it behind our existing chain: 4.2 K (calm) to 7.3 K (terminator) against the met chain 5.0 K storm residual is comparable, and we decline to rank them because the two error mechanisms are independent (horizontal averaging vs model profile shape) and we hold no calm-regime error account for the met chain to rank against. (3) So the move is to combine rather than choose - but on this point we got it wrong twice and have retracted it. The combination itself stands: the mechanisms are independent, so they add in quadrature, and in the storm regime 4.5-16.7 K with 5.0 K gives 3.3-4.8 K, never worse than either input, because that is inverse-variance arithmetic rather than an assumption. What was wrong is what it is WORTH. (a) We had declared a 0.5 storm representativeness factor (dust mixing flattens horizontal structure), while the producer's own spherical-symmetry term runs 1.1 -> 4.2 K - the same physics moving the opposite way by 3.8x. The producer then disclosed that their 4.2 K rests on a declared storm_frac = 2% bracket and is no more measured than ours, so that 3.8x does NOT refute our 0.5; it is simply a second assumption pointing the other way. Neither side can settle it, symmetrically, so the factor is withdrawn and swept 0.5-4.0 with no preference between the ends. What would actually settle it is in-orbit data, and the producer named two observables that are occultation by-products needing no new hardware: (i) the statistics of differences between neighbouring tangent points (~100 km apart) within one storm sol, which give the along-ray horizontal structure amplitude directly, and (ii) the time series of residuals between the occultation lower boundary and the met station p0/T0. Until those exist, 5-12% is the frozen figure. (b) Worse, the headline SUBTRACTED TWO DIFFERENT RULERS: in "+3.89% -> +2.74%, ~30% better" the +3.89% is account 9's CUMULATIVE closed-loop bias (noise + 0.19 K calibration + 0.15 K ground stop included) while the withdrawn +2.74% was the checking script's own four-layer linear T(z)-ONLY estimate. The two scales happen to cross at 4.77 K, and that coincidence is what made the table look self-consistent. The repair: stop estimating the column term and rerun ACCOUNT 9'S CLOSED LOOP for every cell, met-alone reference included (600 trials, agreeing with the frozen value to 0.116 pp inside a 0.482 pp Monte-Carlo tolerance). Result: met alone +3.77%, combined +3.35% (factor 0.5) to +3.72% (factor 4.0) - A GAIN OF 5-12%, NOT 30%. Even under our own withdrawn 0.5 the honest figure is 11.3%, so most of that 30% was a change of ruler rather than a change of error. At the producer's implied 3.8x the gain is 1.7%, below two standard errors and therefore not material. ADOPTED as a SECOND, CO-EQUAL T(z) source below 20 km — not a replacement main source — plus three further roles: independent 20-40 km cross-check (our averaging kernel is only 0.43 there, so an external constraint has the most room), GCM/prior-model validator (63 profiles per sol globally is a more durable job than being one retrieval prior), and surface p0/T0 cross-check for the review-F5 pressure interface. The producer own claim that the footprint is harmless at 20-40 km checks out as self-consistent with our frozen AK 0.43: up there the atmosphere is not terrain-coupled, so an along-ray average of order sigma = 194 km is representative — their claim and our kernel are the same fact seen from opposite sides.

Occultation footprint representativeness, TWO SEPARATE TABLES: a footprint is each product's own attribute and one must not stand in for the other. Mechanisms and thresholds are word-for-word those of the sci-orbiter-01 adjudication, only the geometry input changed: local-time span x boundary-layer slew (3 K/h quiet, 12 K/h terminator) in quadrature with relief x a 2.5 K/km lapse rate, the displacement being the RMS of the Gaussian weighting, i.e. sigma. (3) THE TERRAIN TERM: THE THIRD RULING IS WITHDRAWN, ITS PREMISE VOID (2026-09-05); it becomes THREE ROWS, each naming the ground it describes and who may cite it. On 09-03 this book took the city total, 1438 m uncorrected, because the offset d of the tangent points from the city was unknown and 'of order sigma could not be ruled out'. com-gap has answered (city ledger 744054a): UNDER THE RING SLOTS IT HAD ASSUMED, THE CLOSEST TANGENT POINT TO THE CITY OVER A FULL 136.6-SOL BEAT IS 2248 KM, WITH ZERO PASSES INSIDE 800 KM - d of order ten sigma, not one - and the 'six clustered tangent points' the ruling leaned on were six time samples of one pass. It does not. pois.physics_en: The same storm is an extinction wall at 0.88 um (2pi r/lambda ~ 11) and Rayleigh haze at 1.64 mm (2pi r/lambda ~ 0.006) — choosing wavelength IS choosing penetration, which is the whole case for adding THz to the weather cluster; and a radiometer measures emission, not extinction: what the storm takes away is the prior, not the signal
